baselines.M1: bounded logistic pair features, fit TRAIN and threshold fixed on CAL
baselines.M2: sequence evidence; INPUT_CONTRACT_ONLY until real encoder input exists
baselines.M3: gap/context-aware association; INPUT_CONTRACT_ONLY until real context/truth exists

identity.host_gate: pairs require equal host_id and contig
identity.negative: both truth statuses known and parent insertion IDs differ
identity.positive: both truth statuses known and parent insertion IDs equal
identity.source_copy_and_homology: identity split keys; never inferred from family or coordinate
identity.unresolved: empty/ambiguous truth identity excluded from negative denominator
